briefing: NASDAQ rose 1.2% and the S&P 500 added 0.6% in a clear risk-on session. With 3 open slots and cash above the deploy threshold, we filled all three slots in favor of USAR and DPC (both full multi-signal confirmation) plus KNSA at medium conviction, rather than holding idle cash.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, using signals like price above its moving average, bullish MACD crossovers, and rising trading volume to confirm the trend is real. Today's buys (USAR, DPC, KNSA) were chosen because multiple signals lined up together, which lowers the chance of chasing a false signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入正處於上升趨勢的股票,利用價格高於移動平均線、MACD黃金交叉、以及成交量放大等訊號來確認趨勢是否真實。今日選入的USAR、DPC及KNSA均是因為多項技術訊號同時出現,這樣可以降低追錯訊號的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Growth and tech-adjacent names outperformed as the NASDAQ (+1.2%) led the S&P 500 (+0.6%) higher, a pattern consistent with broad risk-on sentiment rather than a single catalyst. Several momentum candidates also showed volume surges alongside the rally, a sign that institutional buyers were actively participating rather than retail-driven noise. No single headline was cited for today's move since no specific news items were available in this session's feed.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日科技及成長股表現領先大市,納斯達克指數上升1.2%,帶動標普500指數上漲0.6%,反映市場整體風險偏好回升,而非單一消息刺激。多隻具動能的股票同時出現成交量放大,顯示機構資金正積極參與,而非單純散戶炒作。由於本次資訊中沒有具體新聞標題可供引用,故未附上個別消息來源。
